tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt. This sits alongside the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so connections are made over HTTPS and their certificates are verified.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement of the current decision. It says TLS certificate verification is on for all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt. It also notes the separate rule of HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions.

Both points come from the project's recorded decisions (#22 and #25). The earlier decision that turned verification off for dev builds (#20) has been retired, so the file doesn't mention it. I didn't read the file back after writing it.

The Muninn heartbeat also reported 20 hook runs that started and never finished, which may mean a hook is timing out. It doesn't affect this file, but `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` is where to look.
